The price does not ask for little, it asks off a base that is 2.90x normal: quality.reverse_dcf.base_fcf is exactly FY2025 free cash flow and 2.90x the FY2022-2025 average, so the 7.0% implied bar is a floor on the demand rather than a measurement of it, and the claimed 1.50pp gap sits inside the file's own 1.95pp horizon spread.

dives.one_line: The market bought the CNY 1.2 trillion headline and has already given all of it back: 4.12 the day before the groundbreaking, 7.72 four sessions later, 4.08 now, 0.97% BELOW where it started, and the twelve-month move is 100% multiple contraction rather than the expansion TOO_LATE needs. The red team of 2026-09-02 left the label at WATCH and re-ranked the reasons behind it. The BINDING lock is the grade-C book (contract liabilities halved, DSO 314 days, capex at 0.09x depreciation, and a fourth flag the draft missed: four years of revenue inside a 0.74% spread, FY2025 within 0.0074% of FY2024, in a year mainland revenue fell 18.14%). The valuation lock is real but softer than the draft claimed: the -7.88pp gap keeps its sign under the horizon, the base and the cash conversion, and NOT under the filed 9% discount rate, which the draft declared and never varied, where 7.5% puts the gap inside the file's own 2.60pp band and 7.0% flips it. The story lock is gone entirely and that cuts both ways: the retail beneficiary article that drove the +87% basket named this ticker first in its bucket AND printed the correct 25-machine, roughly 6bn sizing, so the market saw the small number and bought anyway and has since unwound, which makes the round trip evidence that the market already corrected rather than evidence of an uncorrected sizing error.

dives.one_line: The market's 5-year reverse-DCF convention asks for a ~36% FCF CAGR against this dive's own 14.41% like-for-like build (a real 21.55pp gap against the file's 16.21pp horizon_spread), narrowing to a non-gap (5.34pp) at the 10-year convention; combined with the single most crowded link on the whole chain (crowdedness 72, zero of four repricing-check legs met, 52-week high set a month before the Hormuz catalyst) and a capture link to the cited occurrence that is thematic (Seagull, same product category) rather than contractual (CENTCOM's own source names a competitor's Knifefish for this mission), the honest read is WATCH on a genuinely clean (grade A) balance sheet and earnings book. Red team (2026-09-04) confirmed the crowdedness read and the earnings-quality recompute unchanged, and amended the priced-in, capture and entry-basis reasoning with a forward-solved price cross-check (this dive's own base case is worth $321.42 at 5y / $474.85 at the excluded 10y, still 32.28% below spot) without moving the verdict.

Real, disclosed device-platform reacceleration net of the divested SmartDose 3.5mL line (HVP Delivery Devices +29.0% Q1 2026, non-SmartDose sub-slice 'up double digits' Q2 2026) sits under a market ask (32.96% five-year implied FCF CAGR) this dive's own 10.67% defended base case cannot close except at the tougher 5-year reverse-DCF convention; the 10-year convention's CAGR-point gap (7.67pp) sits inside the file's own 14.62pp horizon_spread, though the red team of 2026-09-06 found the dollar-space gap still runs 43.4% at that same convention, so 'no measurable gap' at 10 years is a CAGR-point-test result, not a fair-value claim. No figure on disk attributes a GLP-1-specific revenue share to this exact link (only the OTHER, CROWDED elastomer-components placement discloses one, 10%); the red team quantified the ceiling at roughly 11.0% of FY2025 revenue ex-SmartDose 3.5mL and roughly 5.5% for the actual growth-driving sub-slice, both upper bounds, with no customer-concentration disclosure to say whether GLP-1 volume growth's money reaches West or its drugmaker customers. The would_buy_zone ($148.13-$162.54), drawn at DRAFT time, turned out under red-team stress to close the gap table to the file's own base case (percentile 65, above-median) rather than a bear-case-survived price: an actual bear rebuild (trailing 2.1% revenue growth, flat margin) prices the stock 30-43% below the zone's own low end. Grade B, mechanically clean with mild disclosed flags (DSO step-up, deferred-income decline, a CEO and CFO transition within 13 months); grade does not bind the verdict. WATCH survives red team unchanged: not TOO_LATE (guidance raised roughly in step with price, an estimate-revision story), not INVESTABLE (independence test's falsification window, Q3 2026 results around 2026-10-30, has not yet fired).
dives.prior_verdict: WATCH (DRAFT); label unchanged by the red team, would_buy_zone bounds kept but its basis corrected to disclose it prices the base case, not the bear case

dives.one_line: The specific product line this placement sits on (Emission Solutions, 10.27% of FY2025 revenue) is growing slower than the company as a whole (5.60% H1 2026 YoY vs 6.17% company-wide) and far slower than Power Systems (+19.38% Q2 2026), the segment actually carrying the data-center narrative that has re-rated the stock; the chain's own shared_bom note already flags that CAT and CMI's aftertreatment content is 'the same revenue... twice by stage' as their genset sales, so this placement cannot be bought separately. On the market's own 5-year reverse-DCF convention the price asks a 33.79% FCF CAGR against a defended 6.43%-9.32% like-for-like build (24.5-27.4pp gap, outside the file's 15.06pp horizon_spread), narrowing to inside that band (10.3-11.8pp) at the 10-year convention, though a price-space cross-check still shows the base case 55.6%-60.4% below spot even there. Not TOO_LATE: the seventh consecutive decline in this log, and the first for a genuinely new reason (the first six declined because the multiple had not expanded; this one declines because the multiple DID expand, roughly 24.2x to 31.76x EV/operating income over 12 months, but the decomposition cannot honestly attribute that re-rating to the specific occurrence this dive is scored on, which belongs to a different, adjacent product line). On rebase, also inherited WST's corpus-wide finding that this zone (like all six others) is anchored on the dive's own base case rather than a separately built bear case, per method section 7's own wording; not re-derived here, escalated to Ron alongside WST's. Verdict unchanged.
